headline: Biggz AI can review this change before you call it done.
reason: this change touches high-risk territory, so it gets the full four-lens review. Reviewing takes a bit longer, and it makes the result substantially safer.
risk_evidence: lens plan: risk, readability, reliability, resilience

choices.label: Run the review now
choices.effect: Starts the review for this candidate and creates its review lineage; later candidates are asked again.
choices.invocation: biggz review start --subject C:/tmp/subject.json --lineage lineage-consent-001 --lenses risk,readability,reliability,resilience --consent granted

choices.label: Not now, just this once
choices.effect: Skips the review for this exact candidate only; nothing is persisted, and the next candidate is asked again.
choices.invocation: biggz review start --subject C:/tmp/subject.json --lineage lineage-consent-001 --lenses risk,readability,reliability,resilience --consent declined

off_path_note: To turn reviews off for good, run 'biggz rdd disable'.
